express_hero_title: Automatic Mode — Website from a Single Prompt
express_hero_sub: Describe your project in plain words. The Orchestrator plans the architecture, selects the style, builds pages and blocks, renders visuals, and configures SEO / AEO / GEO & CSP automatically.
ph_exp_brief: Describe your business, services, style, and sections you need...
s1_sub: Select the folder on disk where SmartLLM Studio will save your compiled website, styles, 512×512 logo, and visual assets.
s2_heading: Step 2 — Brand Name, Brief & 512×512 Logo (6 Variants)
s2_sub: Enter your website name and short description. Upload your own logo or generate 6 custom 512×512 variants and pick one with a click.
lbl_proj_goal: Short Website Description (what it is about)
ph_proj_goal: Describe your product, services, and target audience...
lbl_logo_section: Website Logo (upload file or generate 6 variants at 512×512)
msg_logo_hint: Click 'Generate 6 Logo Variants (512×512)', then click any card to select it.
s3_heading: Step 3 — Select Visual Style from List
s3_sub: Choose a classical design canon: composition, typography, color, surface, and motion rules. Tokens are applied to the generated site automatically.
s4_heading: Step 4 — Typical Pages and Per-Page Blocks
s4_sub: Select typical corporate pages first, then configure blocks separately for each page. Block sets are matched to the purpose of each page.
s5_sub: Review the brand foundation and contacts, then the block copy for each selected page. This data feeds the pages, JSON-LD, llms.txt and GEO markup.
support_literal_copy: SmartLLM Studio is free. If this project saved you time, consider supporting its development — $0 is fine.
support_license_note: Source-available under FSL-1.1-ALv2 (automatically converts to Apache-2.0 after 2 years). You own 100% of every website, script, and image you generate.
lbl_wallet_evm: USDT · USDC · ETH (EVM: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, BSC)
lbl_logo_prompt: Logo Prompt — describe what you want in plain language
ph_logo_prompt: Example: a strict mark made of two interlocking arcs, deep navy and warm gold, no text. Write in English or Russian.
msg_logo_prompt_hint: SmartLLM expands your brief into a professional Z-Image prompt using the 2026 logo canon: one centered mark, clean colors, legibility at 32 px.
s4_blocks_hint: Select typical corporate pages first, then configure blocks separately for each page. Block sets are matched to the purpose of each page.
s3_palette_note: Palettes are canon-consistent tokens (NN/g, MDN, Tailwind, WCAG), not a single official HEX palette for the style.
s5_company_title: Brand Foundation & Contacts (used in SEO / AEO / GEO)
s5_company_hint: Tagline, positioning, values, priorities, cities, address, phone and email. Review the values — they feed JSON-LD, llms.txt and contact blocks.
ph_s5_positioning: Who you are, for whom, and what outcome you deliver...
lbl_s5_render_visuals: Render Z-Image visuals (per-page heroes, gallery, team portraits)
lbl_motion_hint: Motion 14 + Lenis or Anime.js deliver GSAP-class scroll choreography and spring staggers under 100% offline MIT licenses.
fp_sub: Built-in studio directory browser (works cleanly in any sandbox or OS environment).
starter_status_init: Generating brand brief, logo prompt, matching canon & pages for Steps 2–5 (without slow block autofill)…
